name: NetApp

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Logo of NetApp used since 2020.png, 2880 px wide)

description: NetApp sells enterprise data storage and data management: all-flash arrays and the ONTAP software that runs on them (Hybrid Cloud, 90% of revenue), and storage and data services delivered inside AWS, Azure and Google Cloud (Public Cloud, 10%). Product sales of arrays are 46% of revenue; support contracts on the installed base are 38%; professional services 6%; public cloud 10%. Hybrid Cloud earns a 70% segment gross margin and Public Cloud 84%. It pays a $0.52 quarterly dividend and repurchased $950 million of stock in FY2026.

businessLines.name: Hybrid Cloud
businessLines.how: One-time sales of all-flash and hybrid arrays running ONTAP ($3,194M), annual support contracts on the installed base ($2,636M), professional services ($407M) plus Keystone storage-as-a-service.

businessLines.name: Public Cloud
businessLines.how: Fees for cloud storage, data services and operational services, delivered primarily as-a-service (with related support); the 10-K says the line includes certain resale arrangements.
